scientific_note: Rejected without changing thresholds. The quotient solved every selected real state, including seven where the plain exact solver exceeded 250,000 expansions, and showed 17.6x median / 104x p90 reduction. The gate failed because only 36 rather than 50 states met the structural selection and because the assumed equivalence between the codebase's label-impurity Gini control and the uniform expected-elimination criterion was false. v0.44 must implement the latter explicitly and compare it with an average-cost exact solver.
